decisions: Made src/app/App.tsx the canonical composition root to satisfy the task's expected output path, keeping src/App.tsx as a compatibility re-export and updating the PWA source-contract test.
Feature-detection reads injected environment globals without writing storage or registering workers, so it is safe before first render.
WebKit compat runs through a persistent profile because Playwright WebKit ephemeral sessions cannot persist Blob/File values in IndexedDB; the production seed and storage path are unchanged.
interfaces: BrowserNotice({ environment? }) renders a non-blocking labelled section with role=status message list, README support-matrix link, and session dismiss button.
browserSupport exports CoreApiKey, CoreApiSupport, CoreApiEnvironment, CoreApiNotice, CORE_API_NOTICES, SUPPORT_MATRIX_URL, and supportsCoreApis().
playwright.config.ts adds firefox and webkit projects limited to compat.spec.ts at 1440x900.

payload.taskDescription: Create BrowserNotice and a supportsCoreApis helper for IndexedDB, Web Workers, WebAssembly, and service workers. Mount it in App.tsx as a non-blocking banner that names the reduced capability and links to the support matrix in README. Add firefox and webkit projects to playwright.config.ts alongside the existing Chromium projects. Add e2e/compat.spec.ts to smoke the shelf, demo case, board, search, and settings in Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit without a crash. Add component tests for each missing API and the no-warning path. Do not add new product features.
